# Rules

🔧 autofix with `--fix` · 💡 editor suggestion. Severity is for the `recommended` preset; `strict` raises most warnings to errors.

| Rule | Description | Recommended | |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`api-min-version`](./api-min-version.md) | Disallow UXP and Photoshop APIs that are newer than the manifest's host.minVersion | error |  |
| [`entrypoints-match-manifest`](./entrypoints-match-manifest.md) | Require `entrypoints.setup()` panel and command ids to match manifest.json entrypoints | error |  |
| [`manifest-permissions`](./manifest-permissions.md) | Require manifest v5+ `requiredPermissions` for the network, file system, launchProcess, clipboard, IPC, WebView, user info and alert APIs the code uses | error |  |
| [`no-deprecated-api`](./no-deprecated-api.md) | Flag UXP and Photoshop APIs that Adobe documents as deprecated, with the documented replacement | warn | 💡 |
| [`no-node-builtin-modules`](./no-node-builtin-modules.md) | Disallow Node core modules that UXP does not provide (UXP modules: uxp, fs, os, plus host modules) | error |  |
| [`no-unsupported-css`](./no-unsupported-css.md) | Disallow CSS properties, values, at-rules, pseudo selectors, units and functions that the target UXP version does not support (CSS files, via @eslint/css) | warn |  |
| [`no-unsupported-fs-method`](./no-unsupported-fs-method.md) | Disallow Node `fs` methods that UXP's `require("fs")` does not document | error |  |
| [`no-unsupported-html`](./no-unsupported-html.md) | Disallow HTML elements, attributes and patterns that UXP documents as unsupported (HTML via @html-eslint/parser, and JSX) | warn |  |
| [`no-unsupported-inline-style`](./no-unsupported-inline-style.md) | Disallow unsupported CSS properties in JSX `style={{...}}` objects and `element.style.x = ...` assignments | warn |  |
| [`no-unsupported-web-api`](./no-unsupported-web-api.md) | Disallow browser APIs that UXP does not provide or documents as unreliable | warn |  |
| [`photoshop-await-in-modal`](./photoshop-await-in-modal.md) | Require awaiting batchPlay and history calls inside an executeAsModal target function so the modal scope does not end early | warn | 💡 |
| [`photoshop-handle-modal-errors`](./photoshop-handle-modal-errors.md) | Require handling rejections from core.executeAsModal (only one plugin can be modal at a time) | warn |  |
| [`photoshop-modal-scope`](./photoshop-modal-scope.md) | Require Photoshop state changes (modifying batchPlay, DOM edits) to run inside core.executeAsModal | error |  |
| [`valid-manifest`](./valid-manifest.md) | Catch manifest.json mistakes that UXP accepts silently (lint manifest.json with @eslint/json) | error | 🔧 |
